svg.title: Harmonie (CHR-001) articulated rig parts
svg.desc: Character space: x = 0 is the centre line, y = 0 is the top of the head room and y = 800 is the ground. Paths are at rest. Rig hierarchy (node <- parent): root <- (none); pelvis <- root; torso <- pelvis; neck <- torso; head <- neck; hood <- head; leftUpperArm <- torso; leftForearm <- leftUpperArm; leftHand <- leftForearm; rightUpperArm <- torso; rightForearm <- rightUpperArm; rightHand <- rightForearm; leftThigh <- pelvis; leftShin <- leftThigh; leftFoot <- leftShin; rightThigh <- pelvis; rightShin <- rightThigh; rightFoot <- rightShin; cloak <- torso; scarf <- neck; satchel <- pelvis.
